news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.2% passive stake in Caribou Biosciences via Schedule 13G
news.summary: BlackRock reported a passive Schedule 13G stake of 7,176,404 Caribou Biosciences shares (7.2%) as of June 30, 2026, adding to the growing institutional ownership base that followed the stock's late-June Russell 2000 inclusion.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences participates in H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual Cell Therapy Virtual Conference
news.summary: CEO Rachel Haurwitz took part in a fireside chat on June 30, 2026 discussing Caribou's allogeneic CAR-T pipeline, including vispa-cel and CB-011, with the investor community.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences added to the Russell 2000 Index
news.summary: Caribou was added to the Russell 2000 (and related Russell benchmarks) effective after the June 26, 2026 close as part of FTSE Russell's semi-annual US index reconstitution, expanding its passive and institutional investor base.

news.headline: Caribou shareholders reject officer-exculpation charter amendment at annual meeting
news.summary: At the June 17, 2026 annual meeting, shareholders elected three Class II directors and ratified Deloitte & Touche as auditor, but voted down a proposed charter amendment that would have expanded liability exculpation for company officers.

news.headline: Caribou reports CB-011 dose-escalation durability data at EHA 2026
news.summary: Updated CaMMouflage Phase 1 data in 12 BCMA-naive relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients treated with CB-011 at the recommended dose showed an 83% complete-response rate, 91% MRD-negativity, and 50% still in complete response or better at 15 months; the company reiterated guidance for initial dose-expansion data for CB-011 in the second half of 2026.

news.headline: Caribou reports long-term vispa-cel (CB-010) data in second-line lymphoma at EHA 2026
news.summary: Long-term ANTLER Phase 1 follow-up data presented at EHA 2026 showed vispa-cel, an off-the-shelf CD19-targeted allogeneic CAR-T therapy, producing deep and durable responses in second-line large B-cell lymphoma comparable to autologous CAR-T therapies.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Caribou is widely expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and give a pipeline/cash-runway update around August 11, 2026, per analyst earnings calendars; the company has not yet issued a formal press release confirming the exact date.

catalysts.label: CB-011 dose-expansion data (CaMMouflage trial)
catalysts.detail: Caribou has guided to initial data from the dose-expansion portion of the CaMMouflage Phase 1 trial evaluating CB-011 in BCMA-naive and BCMA-exposed relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Vispa-cel (CB-010) pivotal ANTLER-3 trial start-up and funding
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment on the pivotal ANTLER-3 trial design (a randomized ~250-patient Phase 3 study in second-line LBCL), Caribou is running start-up activities while exploring partnering and other options to fully fund the trial; year-end 2025 cash of $142.8M is guided to fund operations into 2H 2027.

pulse: Caribou enters late July 2026 on continued clinical and institutional momentum: EHA 2026 data in June showed CB-011 delivering an 83% complete-response rate with 91% MRD-negativity in BCMA-naive myeloma patients, while vispa-cel continued to post durable, autologous-CAR-T-like responses in second-line lymphoma. The stock's June addition to the Russell 2000 and a newly disclosed 7.2% BlackRock stake (as of June 30) point to a broadening institutional base, even as shareholders pushed back on a governance proposal to expand officer-exculpation protections at the June 17 annual meeting. With no major company-specific news since the BlackRock filing, investor focus now shifts to Q2 2026 earnings expected around mid-August (unconfirmed) and CB-011 dose-expansion data due later this year, with cash guided to last into 2H 2027 while Caribou explores funding options for the pivotal ANTLER-3 trial.
